newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Wednesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Wednesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Wednesday:

Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said the Commission had agreed during its Tuesday meeting that additional funds for humanitarian assistance in Africa would be necessary and that procedures were in progress.

Spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida said the Commission was extremely preoccupied by the situation in the Great Lakes Region. He said Commissioner Joao de Deus Pinheiro would meet special envoy for the Great Lakes Region, Aldo Ajello, in the afternoon and that a meeting of directors specialized in the region's issues would also take place.
Spokesman Willy Helin said the Commission was expecting a restructuring plan for German construction company Sket GmbH but that no deadline had been fixed (see separate story).

Van der Pas said the Commission had underlined the importance of finding a solution to the Danish opposition to the use of article 235 of the Treaty in the proposed EU action to counter Washington's anti-Cuba trade laws.

Spokesman Peter Guilford added that the Commission believed the use of articles 235, 113 and 73 formed the most suitable legal basis the EU could use for an efficient result to ensure protection of European companies against effects of the U.S. Helms-Burton Act.
In answer to a question Guilford said the Danish opposition came as a surprise to the Commission.

Spokesman Gerry Kiely said that BSE would be dealt with under a procedure financed from the agricultural guarantee fund which was why it was not included in the Commission's animal disease eradication programme.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/96/951: Commission rejects scheme of tax credits awarded to Italian road hauliers as incompatible with the Treaty's state aid rules.
- IP/96/952: Commission finances animal disease eradication programme.
- IP/96/953: State aid: France - Commission approves aid for research and development in the steel industry.
- IP/96/954: State aid: Spain - Commission approves two of three state aids to Opel's Saragossa factory.
- IP/96/955: State aid: Germany - Commission approves aid for Schachtbau Nordhausen GmbH.
- Speech/96/262: Speech by Commission President Jacques Santer to the European Parliament on the European Council in Dublin.
- Taxes and duties at September 1996 - national currencies and Ecus.
